source_text.GH#2583: managed_by: core Records callers bypass the route-level managed-type guard. ACs: (1) enumerate and classify every core caller of Records.create/update/delete; (2) move the enforcement point so no core path writes a managed type without an explicit typed ownership proof, with a boundaries/CI check against new unguarded callers; (3) RecordDeadlineSweep proves ownership or is shown to touch no managed type, with a test; (4) coordinate with REQ-484 / 0054 so step writes use the same check. ORCH rulings OQ1-OQ6 applied (see design section 1).
